mcnemar_test.comparison_name: Condition A (Cold Start) vs Condition C (AI Brain)
mcnemar_test.interpretation: Condition A (Cold Start) vs Condition C (AI Brain) (N=30). Contingency table: Both Pass=0, Second Only Pass=21, First Only Pass=0, Both Fail=9. Discordant pairs=21. Exact binomial p-value = 9.54e-07. The difference is statistically significant (p < 0.05).

mcnemar_raw_vs_brain.comparison_name: Condition B (Raw History) vs Condition C (AI Brain)
mcnemar_raw_vs_brain.interpretation: Condition B (Raw History) vs Condition C (AI Brain) (N=30). Contingency table: Both Pass=17, Second Only Pass=4, First Only Pass=8, Both Fail=1. Discordant pairs=12. Exact binomial p-value = 3.88e-01. The difference is not statistically significant.
